newsitem.title: INDIA: India castorseed prices gain on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: India castorseed prices gain on speculative buying.

text.p: Indian castorseed June delivery prices on Tuesday rose to 1,200 rupees per quintal from 1,191/1,192 rupees on the back of fresh speculative buying, dealers said.
"Lower than expected new crop arrivals at the producing centres as well as fresh export enquiries triggered renewed bull buying while bears were covering short positions," a dealer said.
Arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region dropped to 30,000/32,000 bags (75 kg each), dealers said.
Reports that Indian exporters have finalised export deals for castoroil ready delivery at the rate of 700 dollars per tonne, also helped firm tendency.
Groundnut oil was quiet at 340/341 rupees per 10 kg amid limited arrivals of 50/70 tonnes while physical buying remained at low ebb. Imported palm-oil was steady at 280/281 rupees per 10 kg.

"Market sentiments for the edible oils however remained subdued on expectation of higher arrivals of imported sunflower oil in the next few days as well as on reports of rising new crop arrivals of rapeseed in the producing centres," one miller said.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 514/515 rupees per 15 kg.
